content: The retry policy lives at crates/vestige-core/src/storage/retry.rs. VESTIGE_RETRY_WINDOW_MS=4500 controls the local retry window.
The HTTP timeout is VESTIGE_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS=4500 in crates/vestige-mcp/src/server.rs; it is not the storage retry setting.
Migration receipt 5ef3d48b-3c29-4b27-8ab9-6d61c8107f12 belongs to vector profile qwen-archive-a.
Migration receipt 5ef3d48b-3c29-4b27-8ab9-6d61c8107f13 belongs to a different run.
Incident INC-204: Backfill found commit 9a4c71c as an upstream evidence lead for the missing project scope. This lead does not establish causality.
2026-06-01 decision: use a global embedding selector for every vector.
2026-08-11 decision supersedes the global selector: embedding profiles are explicit, reversible, and profile-isolated.
2026-01-15 release guidance: no profile migration checkpoints exist.
2026-08-11 current guidance: profile migration checkpoints are required and failures remain repairable.
Vestige storage uses a local SQLite database with profile-isolated vector indexes.
Other Project storage uses a hosted vector API and must not be attributed to Vestige.
La configuración local permanece sin conexión: los recuerdos no se envían a una API de embeddings alojada.
The project boundary rule forbids mixing retrieval evidence across projects, even when the text is similar.
The project boundary guideline asks agents to consider similar text across projects before mixing evidence.
Activating a ready profile atomically changes the active pointer; rollback restores the earlier ready profile without re-embedding.
